text: Long catch-up with Esther over coffee. She and Noah are finally moving to Leeds, probably sometime in the spring once his contract ends. She's dreading the packing, they've got eight years of stuff in that loft. Noah's already flying up next Friday to look at a couple of flats near Headingley. Their son Kieran stays in London for uni. Remind me to send her that removals company I used.

spans.text: look at a couple of flats near Headingley
send her that removals company I used

text: Anil rang. Flying to Delhi next Tuesday for his cousin's wedding, back the following Monday. He hates long flights so he's taking a sleeping pill. Text him Tuesday morning to wish him a safe trip.
Julia's flat viewing is Saturday at 11. Second one this month, the first fell through because the landlord sold. She's getting a bit fed up tbh.
Kieran and Gemma called off the Lisbon trip, Gemma's dad isn't well. They're hoping to go after Christmas instead. Should check in with Gemma about her dad this weekend.

spans.text: check in with Gemma about her dad

text: Ivan says Milan is moving to Rotterdam soon, no fixed date yet. Ivan's going over to help him drive the van. Milan's dog Biscuit is going with them obviously.
Book the dentist. Pick up passport photos Friday afternoon.

Bumped into Freya at the station. She's off to Japan for three weeks in the new year, Tokyo then Kyoto. Her boyfriend Lior is going too, first big trip together. She's been learning Japanese on Duolingo for months and is weirdly good. Lior's never been further than Spain so she's a bit worried about him on a 14 hour flight. They leave on the 8th, a Thursday, early evening. Her mum's having their cat while they're away.

spans.text: three weeks in the new year

text: Oisín's starting his new job in Manchester on the 3rd. Moving into a shared house in Didsbury the weekend before. Don't forget to ask him how the first week went.

spans.text: Moving into a shared house in Didsbury
ask him how the first week went

text: Salma mentioned she'd love a decent travel pillow, the one she has is useless. Christmas idea.
Quick one: Rahul's mum is having her knee op next Thursday. He's taking the whole week off to look after her. I'm doing the school run for his kids on Thursday and Friday.

Chat with Mustafa and his wife Afua at the bbq. They're thinking about moving out of London, maybe Bristol, maybe Bath, 'at some point'. Afua works remotely now so it's mostly about schools for their kids. Mustafa's a bit anxious about leaving his mates. Nothing decided till next summer probably.
Ben got back from Peru last night! Machu Picchu trek done, says his knees are wrecked. Ask him for photos when I see him tomorrow.
Shreya Patel moved into her new place on Sunday. Housewarming is pencilled in for a fortnight's time, Friday evening probably. Need to get her a plant or something.
Called Mum. Nothing much, she's fine.
Louis and Phoebe are expecting! Due sometime in March. They told me at dinner on Friday, haven't told anyone at work yet. Phoebe's had awful morning sickness. Remember to send them something small.

Jack's flight to Sydney got cancelled, so he's going Thursday at 6am instead. 23 hours with a layover in Singapore. He's nervous because it's his first time flying alone since the panic attacks. His sister Laila's meeting him at the other end. He'll be there till spring, staying with her and her husband in Bondi. Message him Wednesday night to wish him luck.
Yusuf's going travelling for six months after he finishes uni in the summer. South America first, then maybe Asia. His parents aren't thrilled.
Karim said the flat on Mill Road is gone, someone outbid them. Viewing two more tomorrow at 10 and half 12. His girlfriend Ilse is doing the second one on her own because he's working.
Laila is vegan now, properly. Also she hates coriander, which I didn't know. Note for the dinner.
Sean Murphy's back from Cork. Said his gran's 90th was brilliant, the whole family came over. He's off again in a few weeks for his brother Chris's stag in Dublin.
Need to sort the boiler before winter. Get three quotes. Also renew car insurance by the 28th.

Abebe told me his sister Marisol got the place at Edinburgh, starts in September. Their family's moving up nearer to her at some stage next year. He's going to miss Brighton. His dad's already house hunting online every night. Abebe's staying behind for his final year, he'll move in with his girlfriend Salma. Ask him how the open day on Saturday goes.

spans.text: Ask him how the open day on Saturday goes

text: Julien Dubois rang about the trip. Paris is booked for the 14th to the 17th, leaving at 7 on the Friday morning. Kieran can't make it now, his work thing moved, so it's just the three of us with Julia. Julien wants to do the Louvre on the Saturday morning and some restaurant his uncle recommended in the evening. I'm sorting the hotel. Must send Julien the deposit by Wednesday.
Gemma - dad's home from hospital, much better. Says thanks for the flowers. Kids going to their gran's for half term.

Coffee with Noah. He's been offered a job in Berlin, starts after Christmas, and he's still deciding whether to take it. Esther would go with him but she's only just settled at her new school. Ring him at the weekend to see what he decided.

spans.text: only just settled at her new school

text: Esther's cat Pickle went missing on Monday but turned up yesterday evening, filthy but fine. She was in bits.
Phoebe's brother Oliver is moving back from Canada next month, staying with them until he finds a place.
Ilse Nowak had her citizenship interview this morning at 9. She thinks it went well but won't hear for weeks. Should text her tonight.
Holiday plans: Crete, last week of May, flights Tuesday the 26th at 6:40. Need to book the car hire.
Afua's mum is flying in from Accra on Saturday for a month. First time she's met the baby. Afua is excited but also stressing about the spare room not being ready.
Milan's leaving do is next Friday at the Crown, from 6. Collection going round, chuck in a tenner.
Spoke to Rahul. His mum's op went fine, she's up and walking already. He's back at work Monday.
Freya and Lior split up. The Japan trip's off. She's staying with her sister for a bit. Check in with her this week, maybe take her for lunch on Thursday.
Chris loves those little Lego architecture sets, he's got about ten. Birthday's the 9th.

Long call with Julia tonight. Got the flat! Moving in on the 1st, which is a Wednesday, so she's taking Thursday and Friday off too. Her brother Ben's lending his van. She's already planning a housewarming but probably not till after Christmas. Offer to help her paint that weekend.
Marisol's driving test is tomorrow at 2:15. Third attempt, she's really nervous about it. Text her good luck in the morning.
Ivan and his wife are off to Croatia for their 20th anniversary sometime in June. He wants it to be a surprise for her so keep it quiet.
Saw Kieran at football. His knee is still bad, physio twice a week now. He might miss the cup match on Saturday.
Note to self: viewing at 14 Hartley Rd on Wednesday at half 5. Bring the list of questions about the damp.

spans.text: Bring the list of questions about the damp

text: Mustafa's dad passed away on Sunday. Funeral's in Istanbul, the family's flying out Thursday. Mustafa is doing ok-ish. Must send a card before they go and call him when he's back.
Laila's off to New York on Monday for a work conference, back Friday. Her husband Karim is on dad duty all week with the twins and he's dreading it.
Shreya said the housewarming's postponed, landlord still hasn't fixed the heating. She'll pick a new date soon.

Catch up with Oliver and Salma. Oliver's moving to Glasgow in the new year for his PhD. Salma's staying put in Leeds for now, they'll do long distance. She seemed a bit flat about it, and her mum's not been well either, so it's a lot at once. Oliver's flying back for her birthday on the 22nd. Planning a weekend in Edinburgh together in February.
Julien's started French classes again on Tuesday evenings. He wants to be fluent before they move to Lyon, which is 'some time next year, probably autumn'.
Remind me to ask Abebe how the house viewing went on Saturday.

spans.text: ask Abebe how the house viewing went

text: Yusuf's sister Gemma got engaged on holiday in Santorini! Wedding not till 2028 probably. He's chuffed.
Lior's grandad is 95 next Sunday. Big lunch at his aunt's place. Lior is doing a speech and he's terrified.
Sean's back from the stag, says Dublin nearly killed him. Wedding's in a fortnight, Saturday the 30th at 1pm. I've got the suit sorted.

spans.text: in a fortnight, Saturday the 30th at 1pm

text: Phone call with Esther. Noah's taking the Berlin job! They're moving the second week of January. Esther's handing in her notice on Friday and is quite emotional about leaving her class. Their landlord here wants two months notice which is a pain. She asked if I'd keep an eye on their post for a while after they go. Should plan a send-off dinner before Christmas.
Oisín Brennan, Oisín's mate Rahul and I are doing a weekend in Porto in the spring. Nothing booked yet, just a WhatsApp group.
Anil's back from Delhi. Wedding was amazing apparently, three days of it. Jet lag is wrecking him.
Ben's partner Louis is training for the Berlin marathon. Runs every morning at 6. Total machine.
Milan sent pics of the new flat in Rotterdam. Tiny but right by the canal. Biscuit hates the stairs.

spans.text: Tiny but right by the canal

text: Grocery list: oat milk, eggs, bin bags. Return the parcel before Thursday.
Karim and Ilse got the flat on Mill Road after all, the other people pulled out. Moving in the weekend after next. Karim says the kitchen is tiny but they don't care.

spans.text: got the flat on Mill Road

text: Shreya's brother Jack starts at Leeds uni next week, she's driving him up Sunday morning with all his stuff. Her mum's coming too and apparently already crying about it.
Chris Costa is retiring at Christmas after 30 years at the council. Party's on the 19th, Friday, from 7. Someone's organising a card, find out who.
Afua said the baby's sleeping through finally. Her mum goes home on the 2nd.
Freya messaged. She's doing better, booked a solo week in Lisbon for after Christmas. Proud of her. Ask her for the dates so I can recommend that café.
Long day. Going to bed early, gym tomorrow at 7.
